text.p: Mexican construction and property group Grupo Accion has completed a global initial public offering (IPO) of 33.57 million "B" shares, representing 28.4 percent of the company's capital, the Mexican stock exchange said in a statement.
The proceeds will be used to make prepayments to bank creditors, to pay the costs of development and for acquisition of office buildings, the statement said.
The offer was made simultaneously on markets in Mexico, the United States and Europe.
Some 13.71 million series B shares were offered on the Mexican market at 12.7 pesos per share, the statement said.

"Some 1.99 million ADRs were offered on the international markets, representing 19.85 million series B shares at $16 per ADR," the statement added. ((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7912))
